scope: Fixed-source terminal constitutive and circuit consistency; no new microscopic mechanism
terminal_convention: Physical source grounded; Vds=Vd, Vgs=Vg; no source/drain relabel on negative drain voltage

source_metadata.interpretation: Official Figure 2b standalone 1T output characteristics. Sweep order is preserved; each curve is 0 to 5 to 0 V.
limitations: Device geometry, terminal convention, temperature, and mapping to the target 1T1M cell are not yet confirmed.

source_metadata.interpretation: Independent transistor output sweeps at negative physical Vd. The JSON stores |Vd| and |Id| for the magnitude-domain 1T1M solver.
limitations: The fourth source column is unlabeled and is provisionally interpreted as Id.
Drain/source/body-well wiring and identity relative to the 1T1M cell require experimenter confirmation.
Large-|Vd| gate-independent current is retained and is compatible with a parasitic/body-diode contribution, not proof of one.

legacy_comparison_scope: model.Params() defaults; UI CAL file was not loaded

normal_cycles.calibration: unchanged historical full-group default; NO REFIT; descriptive, not held out
normal_cycles.history: v13 predicts separate protocol pairs; no claim of continuous inter-pair state
normal_cycles.capacity_check_caveat: No experimental uncertainty model; a violation flags transfer/provenance/noise, not proof of active h-BN

baseline_provenance.reproduction: Extract `git archive <source_revision> vulcan2d` into a separate temporary directory. Run that directory's model_v13.simulate_calibrated_cycle on observed_cycle_{4..53}_{set,reset}_voltage from analysis/full_cycle_validation_audit_v13_curves.npz. Save phase Vs/Is/Vhs under cycle{index}_{phase}_{key}; caching only identical voltage-grid pairs is equivalent. Pass this NPZ with --baseline and record the extracted revision with --baseline-source-revision.
baseline_provenance.calibration: Historical default, evaluated on identical native voltage grids; no refit

observation_source.availability: Raw XLSX files are dataless placeholders on this machine; no fresh workbook read was completed
observation_source.interpretation: Re-evaluation of archived native measurements, not independent source verification

limitations: Positive and reverse datasets are from different sources; same cell, body/well wiring and exact device match remain unconfirmed.
A shared measured port law is a circuit consistency result, not a microscopic MOS theory or evidence for a unique parasitic mechanism.
The h-BN model still has separate polarity envelopes and empirical SET-to-RESET handoff.
First three cycles are outside the primary normal-operation score by advisor-informed scope; raw records remain untouched.
Current parameters were trained on historical groups including startup data. These numbers are not a new cycles4--53 refit or held-out prediction.
Legacy desktop defaults remain historical and must not be described as the shared research law.
